conclusion.official_label: none found in local artifacts; no hard/difficulty/mode/unlock token in g1019 game code, map config, UI resources, or manifest

conclusion.one_sentence: Hard mode is the separate m1019_10 map (60 waves, added in manifest revision 10110); it is chosen by the host/dispatcher before the match, not unlocked by a player threshold and not a mid-match wave transition.

proven.claim: m1019_10 has 60 levels and 7,986 required kills; every level's kill threshold equals the sum of its spawn groups.
m1019_10 boss gates are levels 10/20/30/40/50/60; final level 60 is a 258-kill wave with boss 3031.

proven.claim: No hard/difficulty/challenge/nightmare game-mode token exists in v10113 plugin source.

proven.claim: No g1019 map/mode/unlock field exists in m1019_10 config/CSV; only timings, stats, shop and respawn.
proven.evidence: map_keyword_scan.py found no hard/difficulty/unlock/mode tokens; only 'select map time' comment for selectMapTime

proven.claim: Map choice is external: normal old-engine dispatch request has no mapId; client consumes Dispatch.mapId from the response; plugin group start defaults mapId to '' and uses data.mid from dispatch.

proven.claim: No mid-match map switch: plugin selects only the internal scene and increments levels; max level ends the match.
